Once upon a time, when everyone had their heads down and eyes fixed on the ground, there was a person who looked up into the sky. 很久很久以前，在所有人都低头注视地面生活的时代里，有一个眺望天空的人。
In their eyes were twinkling stars. 映照在那人眼中的，是于天空中闪烁的群星。
Connecting the nameless stars no one else would look at, 那人将这些无名的、没有人注目的群星相连，
The person gave them names, and made up stories for them as they liked. 赋予它们名字，随心所欲地为它们编写故事。
Stories are like skeins of thread without an end; 故事就像没有尽头的线团一般；
They're drawn and woven together in an effort to find meaning from meaninglessness. 为了在没有意义的事物中找到意义而编织、而描绘。
All kinds of stories in the world, happy and sad, circled in the night sky. 世间欢乐与悲伤的故事，时常萦绕在夜空之中。
Then one day, the person's family fell deeply sick, their life nearing its end. 有一天，他的家人得了一场重病，眼看着便要死去。
Like any other day, the person spoke into the sky about the grief they felt. 一如既往地，他向着天空讲述着自己悲伤的故事。
And then... 然后……
A droplet of water fell onto the person's head. 然后，有一滴水落到他的头上。
Looking up, the person found the constellation talking to them. 那人抬头望去，发现星座正在与他说话。

'The tears I shed will clear you of your pain.' “我流下的泪水会洗去你的痛苦。”
Afterwards, a rain fell onto the world for a day and a half. 之后，全世界下了一天半的雨。
Everyone caught in the rain was all healed up. 被那雨水淋到的人们，身上所有的病痛都痊愈了。
The person's ill family recovered to health, too. 那人生病的家人也恢复了健康。
